title: Classical Conditioning Breakdown of Phobia or Advertising
description: Deconstruct a real-world conditioned response into its unconditioned and conditioned stimulus-response pairings.
problemStatement:
Select either a specific phobia (e.g., fear of dogs after being bitten, fear of the dentist) OR a television commercial (e.g., pairing a soft drink with attractive celebrities and upbeat music).

### Requirements:
1. Explicitly identify and label the four classical conditioning variables:
   * Unconditioned Stimulus (US)
   * Unconditioned Response (UR)
   * Conditioned Stimulus (CS)
   * Conditioned Response (CR)
2. Detail the acquisition timeline and explain how stimulus generalization might occur.
3. Propose a counterconditioning or systematic desensitization protocol to extinguish the response.
hints: Hint 1: In advertising, the celebrity/music is the US producing pleasant feelings (UR), and the product is the CS.
Hint 2: Extinction requires repeated exposure to the CS without the US.
